verdict.rationale: Persona documents Watchlist, Politically Exposed Person, and Adverse Media report types within its own API. It also documents orchestrating Watchlist and PEP reports on an individual and having workflows run reports as part of the identity process. Cases gives ops teams a configurable review UI, and Accounts groups a user's full history in one place. Missing for 10: explicit naming of sanctions lists within the Watchlist report, documentation that screening hits are adjudicated directly in Cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface
